title.narrative: Support to build confidence among local population and local authorities living in border areas

description.narrative: This 18-month exceptional assistance measure aims to increase community resilience and stability in the concerned border areas by strengthening national emergency response capacity and improving access to shared community assets. Targeted support will be provided to both Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan to build confidence at national level as well as amongst local populations living in border areas, thereby underpinning the recent high level political border demarcation process by concrete actions on the ground. To this end, the planned intervention will work with governments on both sides to put in place light multi-purpose infrastructures and create spaces for joint community activities in border areas, while also enhancing the capacities of emergency response services. Improving access to multi-purpose recreational facilities through the construction of sport/ playgrounds on each side of the border will simultaneously create spaces for youth and broader community engagement and strengthen cohesion during non-emergency times while increasing the shelter capacity in the target districts in case of disasters. Dedicated training and community engagement activities will benefit both local authorities and communities through increased knowhow in disaster risk reduction and preparedness, which will further enhance local response capacity to man-made and natural disasters.
